facts.fact: PREA states that law no. 2014-038 of 9 January 2015 on personal data protection already provides for the CMIL, and that decree 2023-1541 of 6 December 2023 sets its organisation.
Decree no. 2023-1541 of 6 December 2023 sets the powers, organisation and functioning of the CMIL and the processing of personal data.
PREA says it is high time to make the CMIL operational, and on 28 February 2024 held the first meeting of a committee created to do so.
